sloka: प्रतिगृह्य त्रिलोक अर्थम् त्रिलोक हित कांक्षिणः ।गंगाम् आदाय ते अगच्छन् कृतार्थेन अंतरात्मना ॥१-३५-१९॥
transliteration: pratigṛhya triloka artham triloka hita kāṁkṣiṇaḥ ।gaṁgām ādāya te agacchan kṛtārthena aṁtarātmanā ॥1-35-19॥

translations.english: The devatas having received Ganga committed to the welfare of the three worlds went back to their abodes with a sense of fulfilment in their mind.
